name: Lin Huiyin
shortBio: Chinese architectural theorist, aesthetic philosopher, and first female architect of modern China who articulated an East Asian philosophy of spatial form, structural honesty, and historic urban preservation.
centralQuestion: How do classical Chinese wooden architectural forms embody cosmic harmony, structural rationality, and living civic memory?

keyWorks.title: On the Characteristics of Chinese Architecture
keyWorks.description: Seminal aesthetic treatise analyzing timber-frame structural grammar, spatial rhythm, and cultural preservation in Chinese architecture.
